causal_graphs.context: GLD-1 in pAS1 and FOG-2 derivatives in pACTII per Methods, with 20 mM 3-amino-triazole. The inherited Y190 two-hybrid protocol uses selective growth and beta-galactosidase reporting; the plotted plus signs are ordinal and not calibrated binding constants. SKR-1 interaction is retained in every displayed truncation.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected Figure 4D rows 1/2 and construct Methods; ordinal score, not a two-fold affinity change.

edges.mechanism: The score falls from ++++ for 327-aa FOG-2 to ++ for 318 aa; deleting residues 319-327 outside the current FTH interval changes reporter output. SKR-1 remains ++++.
edges.subject: truncate-to-318

evidence.explanation: Figure 4D rows 1/3, retained ++++ SKR-1 control and primary Results.

edges.mechanism: The 299-aa derivative scores +/- rather than ++++; residues 300-327 are outside the current domain. This is residual weak reporter output, not complete absence of all binding.
edges.subject: truncate-to-299

evidence.explanation: Figure 4D row 4 versus full length; no isolated-domain or quantitative detection-limit experiment.

edges.mechanism: Removing residues 264-327 eliminates detected GLD-1 reporter interaction while SKR-1 remains positive. The deletion spans eight current-domain residues and the entire downstream tail.
edges.subject: truncate-to-263

evidence.explanation: Figure 4D row 5 and Methods; explicit 76-aa deletion versus the 74-aa exon-4 description.

edges.mechanism: The 251-aa derivative also lacks detected GLD-1 output but retains SKR-1 interaction. Its deletion spans domain residues 252-271 and tail, not precisely the separate 254-327 exon-transfer segment.
edges.subject: truncate-to-251

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Historical AL110477.1 splice reconstruction exactly matches 327-aa Q2YS43/CAJ43447.1; current PF01827 is 144-271, separate F-box 20-59. The 318/299 truncations remove tail only; 263/251 remove domain 264-271/252-271 plus tail. None isolates the entire FTH domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT construct effects on a yeast reporter, not purified binding affinity or worm sexual fate. Folding, fusion geometry and abundance may contribute despite retained SKR-1 output. Figure 4 labels derivatives Bait whereas Methods places them in activation fusions. Replicate count and quantitative reporter calibration are not supplied.
causal_graphs.scope: Nayak 2005 Figure 4D: 327-aa C. elegans FOG-2 and constructs ending at residues 318, 299, 263 or 251, tested in yeast.
causal_graphs.title: FOG-2 terminal truncations reduce GLD-1 two-hybrid output

causal_graphs.context: Same yeast two-hybrid setup as the truncation study, 20 mM 3-amino-triazole and retained SKR-1 positive interaction. Methods specify GLD-1 pAS1 and derivatives pACTII; the image Bait heading conflicts with this orientation.

evidence.explanation: Figure 4D final two rows and Figure 4B terminal alignment, with the 314/318 and exon-boundary discrepancies retained.

edges.mechanism: FTR-1 has no detected GLD-1 signal, whereas the 327-aa chimera scores +++; both retain ++++ SKR-1 interaction. The transferred segment confers this assay behavior only within the tested FTR-1 fusion context.
edges.subject: transfer-fog2-terminal-exon

causal_graphs.family_mapping: FOG-2 Q2YS43/CAJ43447.1 is 327 aa, PF01827 144-271; FTR-1 G5EC06/CAB54326.1 is 314 aa, PF01827 146-283. Figure 4B shows FOG-2 segment 254-327, combining domain 254-271 with tail 272-327. The experiment is a protein chimera, not purified FTH sufficiency.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT reporter effect. FTR-1 is 314 aa in the image/reference but 318 aa in Methods; exact historical chimera junctions remain unverified. The +++ chimera signal is not identical to ++++ FOG-2. No worm rescue, translational repression assay or family-wide GLD-1-binding transfer is established.

nodes.label: Replace the FTR-1 terminal segment with reported FOG-2 exon 4
GLD-1-dependent yeast two-hybrid output of the chimera

causal_graphs.scope: Nayak 2005 Figure 4B/D: FTR-1 versus the FTR-1/FOG-2 exon-4 chimera.
causal_graphs.title: A FOG-2 terminal segment confers GLD-1 reporter interaction on FTR-1

causal_graphs.context: C. elegans, default 20 C culture; 292 gonad arms from somatically female cross-progeny and 100 male siblings examined. Exact RNAi dose, delivery details, scoring age and contemporaneous untreated counts are not resolved in the inspected primary-paper transcription.

evidence.explanation: Primary-paper Results identifying Y113G7B.5 as fog-2, printed p.5267; text transcription inspected, not raw phenotype images or lab supplements.

edges.mechanism: The reported RNAi treatment yields feminization in 91% of 292 somatically female gonad arms, while male siblings lack the sexual defect. This is the reported intervention phenotype, without a reconstructed untreated effect-size estimate.
edges.subject: fog2-cd13-rnai

causal_graphs.family_mapping: CD13.1 maps to fog-2/Y113G7B.5; historical genomic reconstruction matches 327-aa Q2YS43/CAJ43447.1, PF01827 144-271. RNAi perturbs the transcript/whole protein, not a specific FTH surface.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT organism phenotype with incomplete protocol/control detail. The denominator is gonad arms, not independent animals. Male siblings show no reported sexual defect, so the result is not generalized to XO spermatogenesis. No measured TRA-2 translation rate, RNAi-resistant rescue or isolated-domain mechanism.

nodes.label: Oocyte-producing instead of normally sperm-producing gonad arms

causal_graphs.scope: Clifford 2000 Results: CD13.1-derived double-stranded RNA and sexual phenotype of cross-progeny.
causal_graphs.title: FOG-2-directed RNAi feminizes somatically female germlines

causal_graphs.context: Temperature-sensitive fem-3(q95) strains maintained at 15 C; embryos shifted to 25 C and grown to adults. Oocyte presence scored by compound microscopy, followed by PCR/sequencing of a phenotype-selected subset. Detailed strain construction retains unc-24(e138) and dpy-20(e1282) markers on IV.

evidence.explanation: Primary Table 2, strain Methods and sensitivity Results; 109 phenotyped animals but only 21 selectively sequenced. No measured translation rate or family-wide effect.

edges.mechanism: All eleven sequenced q71 homozygotes occur in the oocyte-positive group; four WT and five heterozygous siblings occur in Mog, with one heterozygote in Fog. The segregating-family result supports a feminizing effect in this background without resolving its molecular mediator.
edges.subject: homozygous-q71-in-e2020-q95

causal_graphs.family_mapping: fog-2(q71) is W148stop in the 327-aa Q2YS43/CAJ43447.1 reference, within PF01827 144-271 but truncating most of the domain and tail. Genotype perturbation is not a single-residue binding experiment. The 108-nt tra-2(e2020) deletion is in a different gene's 3-prime UTR.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT genetic effect. Fog includes self-fertile animals and does not mean sperm-free. Sequencing followed phenotyping, so 11/11 is not an unbiased penetrance estimate. Remaining in-vivo RNA contacts, alternative targets and GLD-1-independent functions are not distinguished. A brief Methods chromosome-I label for fem-3 conflicts with the detailed IV strain construction.

nodes.label: Make fog-2(q71) homozygous in the e2020/q95 sensitized background
Oocyte-producing germline outcome instead of the Mog phenotype

causal_graphs.scope: Hu 2019 Table 2: tra-2(e2020); fem-3(q95) families segregating fog-2(q71), not an otherwise wild-type population.
causal_graphs.title: Loss of FOG-2 shifts germline fate despite the tra-2 UTR deletion

causal_graphs.context: Endogenous nine-residue HA insertion four amino acids before the TRA-2 stop; CP153 derived from JK574 and CP139/CP141, with q71 sequencing and tagged-locus PCR confirmation. Default NGM culture at 20 C; 40 double-mutant animals scored for self-fertility.

evidence.explanation: Expression Results and strain/CRISPR Methods; Figure 3/6 images inspected for the separate expression readouts and retained label discrepancy.

edges.mechanism: Self-fertility is reported in 35% of 40 double-mutant animals despite the untagged q71 sperm-deficient baseline. This supports partial compensation by altered TRA-2, not restoration of FOG-2 protein or a quantified repression constant.
edges.subject: insert-tra2-ha-in-q71

causal_graphs.family_mapping: The deficient member is FOG-2 Q2YS43/CAJ43447.1, PF01827 144-271, affected by W148stop. The intervention alters separate TRA-2, not FOG-2, its FTH domain or an equivalent family member.
causal_graphs.limitations: INDIRECT genetic suppression, not same-gene rescue or a direct binding/translation measurement. Precise scoring age, biological replicate breakdown and contemporaneous untagged denominator are unstated. Figure 3B says nmIs4 while Methods/caption and Figure 6 say nm75. The tagged allele is not a neutral reporter, and suppression remains partial.

nodes.label: Introduce homozygous endogenous tra-2(nm75) into fog-2(q71)

causal_graphs.scope: Hu 2019 Results near Figure 3: XX tra-2(nm75); fog-2(q71) double mutants compared with the reported untagged q71 phenotype.
causal_graphs.title: Modified TRA-2 partially suppresses the FOG-2-null self-fertility defect

discussions.notes: See evidence/PF01827/FOG2-identity.txt and paired primary notes. Historical AL110477.1 splice reconstruction exactly matches Q2YS43, but tagged clones and chimera junctions were not independently sequenced. G219R and G271R/E phenotypes are not loss-of-GLD-1-binding proof. Obtain domain-specific orthogonal assays and rescue.
discussions.prompt: Separate FTH, terminal-tail and whole-protein contributions to FOG-2 function.
discussions.rationale: The mapped 144-271 domain is not the whole 327-aa protein or the transferred 254-327 segment. Five graphs retain eight observed indirect effects without assigning direct molecular sufficiency.

evidence.explanation: Genotype effects, negative expression readouts, detection limits and model assumptions remain separate. Table 2 Fog includes self-fertile animals and its genotyped subset is phenotype-selected.

discussions.notes: See evidence/PF01827/hu-2019-fog2.txt and fog2-gap-ledger.txt. Resolve nm75/nmIs4 labeling and measurement sensitivity, inspect uncurated gene-conversion and mating studies, and independently map other FTR/FTH members. No direct ubiquitination, universal RNA-binding or family-wide sexual-fate mechanism is adopted. Keep IN_PROGRESS with partial self-review.
discussions.prompt: Test the molecular mediator without promoting a genetic model into an observed causal chain.
discussions.rationale: Tagged TRA-2 partly suppresses q71, while FOG-2 loss does not detectably raise germline TRA-2 in the inspected assay. The sensitized e2020 result does not establish a specific alternative RNA target or GLD-1 independence.
